candidate.answerReason: Changing to base 2 gives log_8 2=1/3; equivalently, 8^(1/3)=2.

methods.label: Logarithm as an exponent
methods.explanation: A logarithm asks for the exponent that produces its argument. Here \(2^3=8\), so \(8^{1/3}=2\). Hence \(\log_8 2=\frac13\).
